title: SPEED PONG
oneLiner: Outscore the computer before every rally becomes a blur!
mechanics: Move your paddle up and down to return the ball.
The computer guards the opposite side and improves as rallies continue.
Score when the ball passes the computer paddle.
The ball speeds up after every point.
lose: Lose when the computer scores 7 points first.
scoring: Earn 1 point whenever the ball passes the computer paddle.
